# METADATA.md — Slow City (test fixture)

Publishing language for this channel. Style and boundaries, never copy.

## Title style

City-led, atmospheric, honest about time of day and weather. Vary structure across uploads.

## Description voice

A calm observational voice. The city, the district if verified, the hour, the weather, what the viewer hears.

## Keyword usage

City name, ambience words, the use (study, sleep, focus) where true.

## Tags

Six to twelve: city, district if verified, night or day, ambience, use.

## Hashtags

Two to four.

## Call to action

One line at most.

## Location naming

City always; district or street only when verified. Never guess from architecture.

## Factual claims

No claims about events, safety or history without a source.
